description: Reads one AI receptionist’s procedures, named by id: numbered “when … then …” rules, each a condition (when) and its steps (steps). A condition is party_size_over (people), service_is (service) or first_visit; a step is ask (question), deposit_link (amount and currency, with the ref the AI names it by), book or hand_over. Read-only.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: get_procedures
title: Read the AI receptionist’s procedures
